'''Kinalos''' was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] soldier who served during the [[Imperial Civil War]]. He fought in a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] with [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Samels]] and [[Varshin]].<ref name="Author'sCut" />

Prior to the Imperial Civil War, he lived in unit 2-C, an apartment in a [[Unidentified residential building (Coruscant)|residential building]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. He had at least two sons, a daughter named [[Henia Kinalos|Henia]], and a partner named [[Tanne Kinalos|Tanne]].<ref name="Author'sCut" />

After the [[Second Battle of Coruscant]] in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] successfully reclaimed its former capital, but quickly fell into sectarian infighting after disagreements over who would be proclaimed [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]]. Much of the planet was laid waste, including Kinalos' street. His family was killed and his home was looted and occupied by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Imperial Stormtroopers]].<ref name="Author'sCut" />

After the New Republic reclaimed Coruscant in the aftermath of [[Operation Shadow Hand]], the [[New Republic Army|Army]] was deployed to clear out remaining Imperial forces. Kinalos found himself in the ruined remains of his street. Armed with a [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech]] [[BT X-42 flamethrower|X-42]] [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrower]] and a pair of [[Blaster pistol/Legends|snub pistols]], he cleared Stormtroopers from his ruined home, while reflecting that he would never return there.<ref name="Author'sCut" />

After clearing Stormtroopers from his old home, Kinalos burned the building. He later wrote about his experiences in ''[[The Year of Rage: A Citizen's History of the Coruscant Wars]]''.<ref name="Author'sCut" />
